name: 25109-mtbench-8b-1gpu
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct (target) + yuhuili/EAGLE3-LLaMA3.1-Instruct-8B (EAGLE3 draft head), speculative method `eagle3`, 3 speculated tokens.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1; the draft head follows the target and takes no parallel degree of its own.
architecture: Target: LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, 32 query / 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, hidden 4096, bf16, 8.03B params (~16.1 GB). Draft: one decoder layer over hidden 4096 plus the EAGLE3 fusion fc and a 32000-entry draft lm_head, max_position_embeddings 2048 (~0.85 GB); it takes its embeddings and its dtype from the target.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=4, bounded at 320 requests / 1800 s safety, warmup the first 25% by completion. Single-digit concurrency is the regime speculative decoding is aimed at, so read the metric against the operating point.
workload: guidellm `json_file`, single turn, no prefix_buckets: the 80 MT-Bench first turns in `configs/data/mtbench-turn1.jsonl`, cycled 4 times to reach the 320-request bound. The rows are the first turns of `philschmid/mt-bench`, 10 each of writing, roleplay, reasoning, math, coding, extraction, stem and humanities. Output is fixed at 256 tokens per request (max_tokens=256 with ignore_eos, so generation continues past the natural stop) and sampling is greedy (temperature 0.0, top_p 1.0). Prompt length is the data's own: 65.7 raw tokens mean, min 12, max 349, plus 10 tokens of chat template on every row.
purpose: An 8B chat assistant with a draft model answering short open-ended prompts at four concurrent streams on one GPU.
launch:
# NousResearch is the ungated mirror of the gated meta-llama repo; same weights.
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct

# The draft head is not cached here -- 0.85 GB downloads on first start.
speculative-config: {"method": "eagle3", "model": "yuhuili/EAGLE3-LLaMA3.1-Instruct-8B", "num_speculative_tokens": 3}

tensor-parallel-size: 1
max-model-len: 2048
max-num-seqs: 128
enable-prefix-caching: false
dtype: bfloat16
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
